subject.title: Regression in 2026.7.1-2: cron ANNOUNCE drops Telegram message_thread_id even when job config has threadId

question: Should the cron thread-routing repair in commit `68771ebdfef121191bbe8762d622418083f3cfa8` be backported to the supported stable channel or scheduled for the next stable release?
rationale: The code repair is already on current main; only release ownership can decide the supported-channel timing and backport policy.

options.title: Backport or include in next stable
options.body: Ship the existing narrow repair in the next supported stable release and confirm announce plus failure-alert Telegram topic delivery.

options.title: Defer to normal release cadence
options.body: Leave the repair on main until the ordinary stable release train, accepting the documented General-topic misrouting on the current stable version meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Backport or include in next stable
recommendation.body: Ship the existing narrow repair in the next supported stable release and confirm announce plus failure-alert Telegram topic delivery.
